class Solution:
    def characterReplacement(self, s: str, k: int) -> int:
        c = Counter()              # 字符 -> 出现次数
        left = 0
        result = 0

        for right in range(len(s)):
            # 1. 新字符进窗口：count[s[right]] += 1
            c[s[right]] += 1
            
            # 2. 当窗口不合法时收缩：
            #    while (窗口长度 - max(count.values())) > k:
            #        count[s[left]] -= 1
            #        left += 1
            while((right - left + 1) - max(c.values())) > k:
                c[s[left]] -= 1
                left += 1

            
            # 3. 更新答案：result = max(result, 窗口长度)
            result = max(result, right - left + 1)
        return result

problems.title: LRU Cache
problems.code:
class Node:

    def __init__(self, key, val):
        self.key = key
        self.val = val
        self.prev = None
        self.next = None

class LRUCache:

    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.map = {}
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.head = Node(0, 0)
        self.tail = Node(0, 0)
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = self.head
        

    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        if key not in self.map:
            return -1

        node = self.map[key]

        node.prev.next = node.next
        node.next.prev = node.prev

        p = self.tail.prev
        p.next = node
        node.prev = p
        node.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = node

        return node.val
        

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        if key not in self.map:
            node = Node(key, value)
            self.map[key] = node

            p = self.tail.prev
            p.next = node
            node.prev = p
            node.next = self.tail
            self.tail.prev = node

            if len(self.map) > self.capacity:
                node = self.head.next
                node.prev.next = node.next
                node.next.prev = node.prev
                del self.map[node.key]

        else:
            node = self.map[key]
            node.val = value

            node.prev.next = node.next
            node.next.prev = node.prev

            p = self.tail.prev
            p.next = node
            node.prev = p
            node.next = self.tail
            self.tail.prev = node

#         self.right = right

class Solution:
    def isBalanced(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> bool:
        if not root: return True
        isbalance = True
        def DFS(node):
            nonlocal isbalance
            if not node: return 0

            left = DFS(node.left)
            right = DFS(node.right)

            if abs(left-right) > 1:
                isbalance = False

            return 1+max(left, right)

        DFS(root)
        return isbalance

problems.title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder
problems.code:
# Definition for a binary tree node.
# class TreeNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left
#         self.right = right

class Solution:
    def buildTree(self, preorder: List[int], inorder: List[int]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        index = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(inorder)}
        self.preindex = 0
        
        def DFS(l, r):
            if l > r:
                return
            root_val = preorder[self.preindex]
            self.preindex += 1

            root = TreeNode(root_val)
            mid = index[root_val]

            root.left = DFS(l, mid - 1)
            root.right = DFS(mid + 1, r)
            return root

        return DFS(0, len(inorder) - 1)

class Solution:
    def lastStoneWeight(self, stones: List[int]) -> int:
        heap = [-x for x in stones]
        heapq.heapify(heap)
        # print(heap)
        
        while len(heap) > 1:
            a = heapq.heappop(heap)
            b = heapq.heappop(heap)

            tmp = a - b
            heapq.heappush(heap, tmp)

        return -heap[0]

class Solution:
    def letterCombinations(self, digits: str) -> List[str]:
        if not digits: return []
        res = []
        path = []

        letters = {
            "2": "abc",
            "3": "def",
            "4": "ghi",
            "5": "jkl",
            "6": "mno",
            "7": "qprs",
            "8": "tuv",
            "9": "wxyz",
        }

        def backtracking(index):
            if len(path) == len(digits):
                res.append("".join(path))
                return


            for ch in letters[digits[index]]:
                path.append(ch)
                backtracking(index+1)
                path.pop()

        backtracking(0)

        return res

class Solution:
    def pacificAtlantic(self, heights: List[List[int]]) -> List[List[int]]:
        rows, cols = len(heights), len(heights[0])
        pacific, atlantic = set(), set()

        def dfs(r, c, visited, prev):
            if r < 0 or c < 0 or r >= rows or c >= cols: return
            if heights[r][c] < prev: return
            if (r, c) in visited: return
            visited.add((r, c))
            dfs(r-1, c, visited, heights[r][c])
            dfs(r+1, c, visited, heights[r][c])
            dfs(r, c-1, visited, heights[r][c])
            dfs(r, c+1, visited, heights[r][c])

        for r in range(rows):
            dfs(r, 0,        pacific,  heights[r][0])        
            dfs(r, cols - 1, atlantic, heights[r][cols - 1]) 

        for c in range(cols):
            dfs(0, c,        pacific,  heights[0][c])  
            dfs(rows - 1, c, atlantic, heights[rows - 1][c]) 

        return [[r, c] for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols)
                if (r, c) in pacific and (r, c) in atlantic]

class Solution:
    def canFinish(self, numCourses: int, prerequisites: List[List[int]]) -> bool:
        adj = defaultdict(list)
        indegree = [0] * numCourses
        # 1. 建图

        q = deque()
        # 2. 所有 indegree == 0 的课入队
        for c1, c2 in prerequisites:
            indegree[c1] += 1
            adj[c2].append(c1)

        for c1 in range(numCourses):
            if indegree[c1] == 0:
                q.append(c1)

        finished = 0
        while q:
            c1 = q.popleft()
            finished += 1
            for c2 in adj[c1]:
                # 3. indegree 减到 0 就入队
                indegree[c2] -= 1
                if indegree[c2] == 0:
                    q.append(c2)

        return finished == numCourses

class Solution:
    def minCostConnectPoints(self, points: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        # kruskal
        parent = list(range(len(points)+1))

        def find(x):
            while parent[x] != x:
                parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
                x = parent[x]

            return x

        def union(a, b):
            ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
            if ra == rb: return False
            parent[ra] = rb
            return True


        n = len(points)
        edges = []
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                x1, y1 = points[i]
                x2, y2 = points[j]
                cost = abs(x1 - x2) + abs(y1 - y2)
                edges.append((cost, i, j))

        edges.sort()                          
        total = 0
        for cost, i, j in edges:
            if union(i, j):                  
                total += cost
        return total

        # prim

        visited = set()

        total = 0

        while len(visited) < n:
            cost, i = heapq.heappop(heap)
            if i in visited: continue
            visited.add(i)
            total += cost
            for j in range(n):
                if j not in visited:
                    heapq.heappush(heap, (abs(points[i][0]-points[j][0])+abs(points[i][1]-points[j][1]), j))
            
        return total
